title: Structuring an unordered text document
answer_short: a model that uses TextRank for keyword extraction and cosine similarity with Google's USE embeddings
answer_rationale: The model uses TextRank (Text 6, Text 4) to extract keywords and calculates sentence similarity using cosine similarity of embeddings generated by Google's USE (Text 7). The model is described as restructuring unordered documents by clustering sentences around keywords, with similarity computed using both keyword and existing sentence similarities (Text 9).
